title: Co-op camera framing: sideways and circle
intro: Reset Scripts first (TestGuide 1.1 shows the distance live). The main pawn next to the Arisen; co-op starts by itself; mouse and keyboard hands off.

steps.text: Run the main pawn to the RIGHT across the screen, stop at ~15 m
Run him LEFT, past the Arisen, stop ~15 m on the other side
Circle around the Arisen at 10-15 m
Run him back next to the Arisen

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.pscr: local p=H.pawn(0):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.disp: local ok,s=pcall(imgui.get_display_size); return ok and s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'n/a'
